verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI app-building SaaS, but nothing in the evidence shows Figma Make can be deployed or run on user-controlled infrastructure. The custom-domain feature applies to published apps on Figma's hosting, which is an adjacent capability and not self-hosting the product. Community reports that users had to reverse-engineer .make files to extract code point the other way, toward a closed, hosted-only product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
